answer_prose: In Boston’s matched sample, runners with an earlier recorded Boston finish slowed by 9.7% between the two 20 km blocks, versus 10.6% for first-recorded Boston runners. That association does not isolate the benefit of knowing the course.
detail_prose: A first appearance in this export may not be a runner’s first visit to the course, and returning runners are a selected group.
